dog.description_text:
Say bonjour to Marseille, a stunning 2 year old, 10-pound cat…or chat, if you prefer to use the French translation for the word cat! ;-)

Marseille could be the chillest dude you’ll ever meet. Sure, he is playful and loves running around with his toys, but you can always count on him to sit next to you on the couch and nestle right into you, whenever you’re in the mood for some feline love! Super affectionate, Marseille is always down for an ear scratch, a head rub, or being pet anywhere and everywhere.

As easy-going as they come, Marseille gets along well with humans, dogs, and other cats. He is gentle, graceful, peaceful, happy, and fun to be around. He is a good eater and enjoys a variety of kitty treats. Fully litter-box trained, Marseille does all his business in his pan, and he keeps his beautiful lush coat neat and clean. Fantastique!

Marseille is a very special boy and will make a fabulous companion for anyone in the marketplace for a young, handsome, interesting, engaging cat.

If you would like to adopt this wonderful cat, please email rescue@pupstarzrescue.org or visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
